items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: He finally changed her to by the name of Georgia Gibbs. Really? He changed her name to Georgia Gibbs. It was, I can't remember her.

ctx.x: Richard Hymnlessed was in several businesses. This is the guy you're talking about.

He was a producer. He was a, he had a brain that was so fast that people hated him. He, he, there was a girl by the name of, I can't remember her first name, but he finally changed her to by the name of Georgia Gibbs. Really? He changed her name to Georgia Gibbs. It was, I can't remember her.
It was an awful name if I remember.
